postTitle: Hi Scott, Norev Durok is back here!.
postSubject: Hi, I'm Norev Durok, do you remember me? i'm the user that you banned because i've been ''spamming'' the same thing over, and over again.Let's just say that i was laughing when you banned me from here, i wasn't even sad, i was literally laughing, i knew that saying something like else should affect people like you.........But i didn't came back to fight again...i came back to forget...I'll explain it in a way that will sound stupid anyways:I don't feel right...and i know what it is: it is that i can't move on, and i know why, because i hate you...and right now i see that that's not right, it's not right to hate someone for something that probably wasn't his fault...moreover, i'm starting to ''regret'' what i've said about ''come back when you...'' well, i won't write it again, because i know that it's not right.I know you may not even read this, but i ask you:Let's just forget everything that happened: let's just forget that i made a hate thread, let's just forget that you banned me and i laughed with that, let's just forget that a fight happened, because i know that this has affected you too, that's why i ask you to forget all that too.I'm basically saying that ''i'm sorry'', and that i won't do that again......I'll forget what happened before, but i'll understand if you don't want to forget it.That's all i wanted to say.
